skill.name: hyperframes-media
skill.description: Prepare media assets for HyperFrames compositions. It guides local text-to-speech, transcription, and background-removal commands for voiceovers, captions, and transparent overlays.
skill.summary: Guide HyperFrames TTS, transcription, and background removal workflows.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Seven static findings are confirmed because the skill documents npx, pip, brew, or apt-get commands that can execute code or modify the host. The remaining findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, standard cache paths, a relative documentation link, or non-reconnaissance prose. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External command execution through HyperFrames CLI examples.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running commands and show input paths, output paths, and resolved package sources.

remediation.issue: Package manager installation guidance for Python and system dependencies.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer pinned versions and documented prerequisites; avoid automatic brew, apt-get, or pip installs.

remediation.issue: Large model downloads and cache writes are part of normal operation.
remediation.suggestion: Publish model source, checksum, size, and cache location so users can verify downloads and manage disk use.

content.value_statement: Media-heavy compositions need clean voiceover, captions, and transparent subjects. This skill guides local HyperFrames commands for TTS, transcription, and background removal.
actual_capabilities: Guide HyperFrames text-to-speech commands for local voiceover generation.
Help choose Kokoro voice IDs, language overrides, and speech speed settings.
Transcribe audio, video, subtitle, and OpenAI response files into word-level timestamps.
Recommend Whisper model sizes and language settings for accurate captions.
Guide background removal outputs for transparent WebM, MOV, and PNG assets.
Explain hole-cut plate workflows for text behind a subject.
limitations: Requires local Node, Python, and media dependencies outside the skill file.
First runs can download large model files and use significant disk space.
Does not create inpainted clean plates or fill removed background areas.
Output quality depends on source media, selected models, and available hardware.

use_cases.title: Create Narrated Product Demos
use_cases.description: Generate local voiceover files from scripts and choose a suitable voice for the message.

use_cases.title: Prepare Caption Timing
use_cases.description: Transcribe recorded audio or video into word timing data for HyperFrames captions.

use_cases.title: Build Text Behind Subject Layers
use_cases.description: Create transparent subject cutouts and inverse plates for layered composition effects.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-media to create narration.wav from this script with a warm English voice: [paste script].

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe a Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-media to transcribe my video into word-level captions. The spoken language is Spanish.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-media to prepare a transparent presenter video for a HyperFrames composition.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Layered Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a TTS, transcription, and text-behind-subject workflow for a 30 second product announcement.

output_examples.input: Generate narration for a short product intro with a friendly voice.
output_examples.output: The response recommends a voice, speed, output filename, and local command sequence for the WAV file.

output_examples.input: Transcribe a Spanish explainer video for captions.
output_examples.output: The response recommends a multilingual Whisper model, Spanish language setting, and caption review steps.

output_examples.input: Place a headline behind a presenter in a HyperFrames scene.
output_examples.output: The response provides an asset plan with a subject cutout, inverse plate, and layer placement notes.

best_practices: Confirm the spoken language before choosing English-only Whisper models.
Use text files for long scripts and split long voiceovers into segments.
Review command paths, output paths, model downloads, and disk use before running tools.
anti_patterns: Do not use English-only Whisper models for unknown or non-English audio.
Do not use background-output when the user needs an inpainted empty room.
Do not run package installs or model downloads without user approval.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: No API key is required for the documented local TTS, transcription, and background-removal commands.

faq.question: Where are downloaded models stored?
faq.answer: The skill documentation states that models are cached under the local HyperFrames cache directory.

faq.question: Can it create caption timing?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides transcription workflows that produce word-level timestamps for HyperFrames captions.

faq.question: Can it remove a person and fill the background?
faq.answer: No. It can create transparent layers, but clean background filling requires an inpainter.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users review before running commands?
faq.answer: Users should review package sources, input paths, output paths, model sizes, and disk usage.
